name: remote-control-desktop
description: Local Wi-Fi iPhone remote control desktop host.
author: Personal project

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @mac-remote/protocol && tsc && node scripts/build-native.mjs && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.pack:app: node scripts/assert-macos.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.pack:mac: node scripts/assert-macos.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/assert-macos.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.pack:win: node scripts/assert-windows.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/assert-windows.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip
